items.title: Show HN: Monitor Postgres Health
items.contentSnippet:
Hello, my name is Danny and I created dbhealth to monitor postgres. I have an SRE background and was working in data eng for a couple years.
dbhealth provides verdicts on health and exposes these through:
- statsd
- prometheus
- OTLP
- Turbostats (the protocol that powers https://control.turbolytics.io/)
dbhealth also provides table freshness by profiling the most recent row available.
Happy to answer any questions. Thank you!

items.title: Show HN: Personal Agent Proxy (Open Source)
items.contentSnippet:
Every (personal) agent (like Muse, Instinct, Grokbot, Poke) asks you to connect your email, calendar, and tools again. Permissions are intransparent and every provider ends up building the same integrations.
We think there needs to be an independent tool that holds all connections to third party companies.
That way you can keep auth separate, audit what an agent does, set fine-grained permissions and easily switch between the agent apps.
I built this over the last few days with my friend Konsti.

items.title: Our Rooms Are Full of Collective Intelligence. We Need Collective Measurement.
items.contentSnippet: What does it mean to be educated if our transcripts cannot capture the student who made every group around them smarter? In this new piece, Jane Shore challenges the foundational assumption of traditional assessment, that learning lives inside individual heads, and invites education leaders to imagine what becomes possible when we measure contribution, collective growth, and ripples of impact alongside academic knowledge. This is essential reading for anyone rethinking what counts, and for whom.
